svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 08 · San Diego · 11/12 Library Walk (Common)
svg.desc: The long walk up the middle of campus, club tables on both sides, the library at the end. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
